safety_findings: The principal claim risk is treating retrospective reconstructions and descriptive artifact cards as equivalent to observed testing, revision, or completed handoffs. Preserve their existing labels and distinguish what the underlying records actually establish.

The candidate appropriately bounds historical production, current research, collective authorship, public-account interactions, and archived civic guidance. No protected coursework was projected as present proficiency in the reviewed public surfaces.

recommendation: Hold PR-016 advisory acceptance. The method is clear and the project connections are strong, but the exceptional threshold needs three better-evidenced loops. Provide bounded, public-safe examples connecting an observed need to a model, interface, actual use, and documented continuation; label missing stages openly. Do not expose protected records to close the gap. This scorecard does not establish the required three-reader median or deployment approval.
